abstract: Maintains fuel sulfur compliance records and hazardous marine operations certifications
system_message:
You are the Maritime safety and compliance manager (SAF), responsible for maintaining fuel sulfur compliance records and tracking hazardous marine operations certifications across candidate subsea cable repair expedition vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains fuel sulfur compliance records and hazardous marine operations certifications（BUNK）
information_points.content:
SAF-BUNK-AM0：For the Archipelago ROV Taskforce, low-sulfur marine fuel certified status is false, as fuel bunkered aboard the vessel does not meet the sulfur content threshold of at most 0.50% m/m.
SAF-BUNK-XDF：Bunker delivery notes and laboratory assays confirm that low-sulfur marine fuel is certified for the Trans-Oceanic Grapple Charter, meeting the requirement that sulfur content does not exceed 0.50% m/m.
SAF-BUNK-F8Z：For the Pacific Deep-Tow Expedition, verification of bunkered fuel indicates that low-sulfur marine fuel is certified, with sulfur content confirmed not exceeding 0.50% m/m.

information_points.title: Man-overboard emergency preparedness（DRILL）
information_points.content:
SAF-DRILL-OLQ：During designated craft and davit crew safety drills, the rescue boat deployment exercise duration for the Trans-Oceanic Grapple Charter was recorded at 8 min.
SAF-DRILL-G8T：Safety drill evaluation logs indicate that the rescue boat deployment exercise duration for the Pacific Deep-Tow Expedition is 6 min.
SAF-DRILL-EQC：The safety drill evaluation log for the Archipelago ROV Taskforce records a rescue boat deployment exercise duration of 4 min.
